Q: Shortcut for command line directory change cd in Windows? A:

I applied the same method to make ~ work in both cmd and powershell.

i search with windows search bar at Path, then add in User vars, path: a new folder in my C:\Username\AppData\Local\scriptfolder

then trough code i created a file called ~.cmd and there I added in %USERPROFILE% saved it restarted cmd, ~ worked. started powershell tried ~ worked as well.

so indeed if you want www to be a shortcut of that created a file www.cmd in a file that has been in the path variables. and in that file you could indeed add cd C:\www

Q: Gradle Build Failing: Could not get unknown property 'RunTheProgram' for object of type org.gradle.api.plugins.internal.DefaultJavaApplication A:

mainClassName requires a string, as otherwise RunTheProgram is considered a project property:

mainClassName = 'RunTheProgram'

However, looking at example #2 of the Application Plugin documentation, the correct way of configuring the main class is:

application {
    mainClass = 'RunTheProgram'
}

(no mainClassName)

Q: How to reset state beforeEach/afterEach jest test? A:

Faced this problem by chance, here the alternative solution (in the case you render a component in each test):

  1. get unmount as render output

    const { getByTestId, queryByTestId, unmount } = render(

  2. use it in the end of your test

    unmount()

But in the modern testing library render must be cleaned automatically after each test, using afterEach(cleanup) is not necessary

Q: How can I avoid redundant comparisons when checking rectangle overlaps in C#? A:

You can go even further: additionaly store the squares of the semi-diagonals to quickly calculate the square of the sum (a+b)^2 and compare this result with the square of the green line length to avoid calculating square roots.
